answers.core: This is a gdscript language feature and therefore can't be made into an add-on
answers.workaround:
It *can* be worked around by adding a node of the specific type below and attaching the script on that one, but it's not really a comfortable way of doing things

Another way would be to outsmart the type system:
```gd
var body = self
body.some_func_on_body()
```
But this is confusing to read and does not benefit from type checks

title: Allow stricter base types when extending a script
